title: Subscription refunds
body: Subscriptions can be refunded in full within 30 days of the charge. After 30 days the charge is final, but you can cancel to stop the next renewal.
answer: You can get a full refund within 30 days of the charge. After that the charge is final, but cancelling stops the next renewal.

title: Subscription refunds
body: Subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of the charge.
answer: You can get a refund within 14 days of the charge.

title: Annual plan refunds
body: Annual plans are refunded pro rata for unused months when the request arrives within 60 days of the charge.
answer: Annual plans get a pro rata refund for the unused months if you ask within 60 days of the charge.

title: Invoiced enterprise contracts
body: Invoiced enterprise contracts are not refunded through the help desk. Billing credits are handled by the account manager.
answer: Invoiced enterprise contracts aren't refunded through the help desk. Your account manager handles billing credits.

title: Hardware shipping
body: Hardware orders ship within 5 business days of payment.
answer: Hardware orders ship within 5 business days of payment.

title: International hardware shipping
body: International hardware orders ship within 10 business days. Customs fees are paid by the recipient.
answer: International hardware orders ship within 10 business days, and customs fees are paid by the recipient.

title: Seat reassignment
body: Workspace admins can reassign a seat to another member at any time from the Members page.
answer: A workspace admin can reassign the seat to another member at any time from the Members page.

title: Education plan seats
body: Seats on education plans are locked to one member for the academic term and cannot be reassigned until it ends.
answer: Education plan seats are locked to one member for the academic term, so the seat can't be reassigned until the term ends.

title: Workspace data export
body: Workspace owners can export workspace data as JSON from Settings, then Export.
answer: Workspace owners can export the data as JSON from Settings, then Export.

title: Deleted workspaces
body: Deleted workspaces are kept for 14 days. Owners can restore and export a deleted workspace during that window. After 14 days the data is purged and cannot be exported.
answer: Deleted workspaces are kept for 14 days. Within that window the owner can restore and export it; after 14 days the data is purged and can't be exported.

title: Password reset
body: Members can reset a password from the sign-in page. Password reset links expire after 1 hour.
answer: Request a new password reset link from the sign-in page. Reset links expire after 1 hour.
